labels.phrase: c ssrs since last visit version

decision.rationale: C-SSRS is the Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale per its abbreviation entry; the study instruments entry describes this Since Last Visit Version as a scale.

qualifiers: include Cr for eGFR calculation and glucose
spellings: Chemistry panel (include Cr for eGFR calculation and glucose)

decision.rationale: The label names the ECG procedure; the footnote and the 12-lead ECG measurements entry describe how ECGs are performed, and the machine-read intervals and heart rate it mentions are several results, not one test the row names.
Insulin is one analyte, measured fasting through the central lab; the cited test row has domain LB.
Follicle-stimulating hormone is one analyte tested by the central laboratory at Visit 1; the cited test row has domain LB.
Free fatty acids is one analyte listed among the Laboratory Tests and performed by the central laboratory, a laboratory test result (LB).

labels.phrase: hand out diary instruct in use
spellings: Hand out diary, instruct in use

decision.rationale: The label names immunogenicity together with a PK (pharmacokinetics) sample: the context gives an ADA assay against tirzepatide and a PK sample collected at the same time points, so the row carries two results.

labels.phrase: injection training with autoinjector demonstration device
spellings: Injection training with autoinjector demonstration device

decision.rationale: Training the participant with a demonstration device is not an assessment.

The abbreviation entry reads IWQOL-Lite-CT as Impact of Weight on Quality of Life-Lite-Clinical trials and the instruments entry calls it a 20-item PRO instrument; CT here is part of the instrument name, not computed tomography.
The footnote describes counselling on diet and exercise, which is not an assessment.
The context lists the stored specimens (serum, EDTA plasma, P800 plasma) but names nothing measured in them.

labels.phrase: participant returns study drugs and injection supplies
spellings: Participant returns study drugs and injection supplies

decision.rationale: Returning study drug and supplies is drug accountability handling, not an assessment.
PGIS is the Patient Global Impression of status for physical activity per its abbreviation entry; the instruments entry describes a patient-rated item on a 5-point scale.
A whole blood sample stored for pharmacogenetic analysis; the purpose speaks of genetic variants in general and names no test.
Registering the visit in the interactive web-response system is an administrative step, not an assessment.
Reviewing goals is reinforcement of lifestyle modifications per the footnote, not an assessment.

labels.phrase: review study participant diary including study drug compliance
spellings: Review study participant diary, including study-drug compliance

decision.rationale: The instruments entry lists the Self-Harm Follow-up Form as a form, triggered by the Self-Harm Supplement Form per the footnote.
The instruments entry lists the Self-Harm Supplement Form as a form administered with the C-SSRS and PHQ-9.
One pregnancy test in serum, by the central laboratory at Visit 1; the cited test row has domain LB.
SF-36 is the Short-Form-36 Health Survey version 2, acute form per its abbreviation entry; the instruments entry calls it a 36-item patient-administered measure.
TZP is tirzepatide and PK is pharmacokinetics per the abbreviation entries; the context gives plasma tirzepatide concentrations by liquid chromatography mass spectrometry, a drug concentration (PC).

flags: slash is part of a test name: albumin/creatinine (ALBCREAT)

decision.rationale: The slash is part of one ratio test: the context gives UACR (urine albumin mg/dL/creatinine g/dL=UACR mg/g) in urine by the central laboratory, a laboratory test result (LB).
One pregnancy test in urine at Visit 3; the cited test row has domain LB.
